from pathlib import Path
import json, datetime, subprocess, shutil, os, stat, urllib.request
root = Path(r'D:\ProjectPackage\Int\IntRuoyiMaintance')
backend_main = Path(r'D:\ProjectPackage\Int\IntRuoyi\ruoyi-vue-pro')
frontend_main = Path(r'D:\ProjectPackage\Int\IntRuoyi\yudao-ui-admin-vue3')
task_id = '20260709-codeonly-three-env-head-release'
task = root / 'doc' / 'tasks' / task_id
evidence = task / 'evidence'
evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
release_tag = 'release-20260709-codeonly-three-env-head-v10'
base = Path(r'D:\ProjectPackage\Int\IntRuoyiWorktrees\r260709ce')
allowed_root = Path(r'D:\ProjectPackage\Int\IntRuoyiWorktrees').resolve()

def run(cmd, cwd=None, timeout=120, check=False):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=timeout)
    if check and p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'command failed {cmd}: exit={p.returncode}\nSTDOUT={p.stdout[-3000:]}\nSTDERR={p.stderr[-3000:]}')
    return p

def append_once(path, marker, text):
    old = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8') if path.exists() else ''
    if marker not in old:
        path.write_text(old.rstrip() + '\n' + text + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

def read_json(name):
    p = evidence / name
    if not p.exists():
        return {'status': 'MISSING', 'path': str(p)}
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def health(timeout=10):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:48181/actuator/health', timeout=timeout) as resp:
            body = resp.read(4096).decode('utf-8','replace')
            return {'statusCode': resp.status, 'body': body, 'passed': resp.status == 200 and 'UP' in body}
    except Exception as ex:
        return {'error': repr(ex), 'passed': False}

summary = {
    'phase': 'final-closeout-retry-after-main-runtime-restart',
    'releaseTag': release_tag,
    'checkedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),
    'operations': {
        'build-release': read_json('build-release-v10-result.json'),
        'publish-test': read_json('publish-test-v10-result.json'),
        'mark-tested': read_json('mark-tested-v10-result.json'),
        'promote-prod': read_json('promote-prod-v10-result.json'),
        'promote-backup': read_json('promote-backup-v10-result.json'),
    },
    'remoteVerification': {
        'test': read_json('publish-test-v10-remote-verification.json'),
        'prod': read_json('promote-prod-v10-remote-verification.json'),
        'backup': read_json('promote-backup-v10-remote-verification.json'),
    },
    'cleanup': {},
    'git': {},
}
operation_ok = all(v.get('status') == 'SUCCESS' for v in summary['operations'].values())
verification_ok = all(v.get('status') == 'SUCCESS' for v in summary['remoteVerification'].values())
if not operation_ok or not verification_ok:
    out = evidence / 'final-closeout-retry-precondition-failure.json'
    summary['status'] = 'FAILED'
    summary['operationOk'] = operation_ok
    summary['verificationOk'] = verification_ok
    out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','path':str(out),'operationOk':operation_ok,'verificationOk':verification_ok}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(2)

# Verify runtime is now main path, not temp path.
inspect_script = r'''
$procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'runtime-control-maintenance|r260709ce|IntRuoyiMaintance\\backend' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine
$ports = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 48181 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess
[pscustomobject]@{ Processes=$procs; Ports=$ports } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
'''
inspect = run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-Command',inspect_script], cwd=root, timeout=60, check=True)
summary['cleanup']['runtimeProcessInspection'] = inspect.stdout
summary['cleanup']['runtimeHealthBeforeDelete'] = health()
if 'r260709ce' in inspect.stdout or str(root) not in inspect.stdout or not summary['cleanup']['runtimeHealthBeforeDelete'].get('passed'):
    out = evidence / 'final-closeout-runtime-not-main-blocker.json'
    summary['status'] = 'BLOCKED'
    out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','path':str(out),'reason':'runtime-control is not proven to run from main path'}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(3)

# Verify no r260709ce registration remains.
repos = [root, backend_main, frontend_main]
registered_hits = []
for repo in repos:
    listing = run(['git','-C',str(repo),'worktree','list','--porcelain'], timeout=120, check=True).stdout
    for line in listing.splitlines():
        if 'r260709ce' in line:
            registered_hits.append({'repo': str(repo), 'line': line})
summary['cleanup']['registeredHitsBeforeDelete'] = registered_hits
if registered_hits:
    out = evidence / 'final-closeout-residual-registered-blocker.json'
    summary['status'] = 'BLOCKED'
    out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','path':str(out),'registeredHits':registered_hits}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(4)

# Safe delete only exact temp root residual.
def on_rm_error(func, path, exc_info):
    os.chmod(path, stat.S_IWRITE | stat.S_IREAD | stat.S_IEXEC)
    func(path)

removed = []
if base.exists():
    resolved = base.resolve()
    if not (str(resolved).lower().startswith(str(allowed_root).lower()) and base.name == 'r260709ce'):
        out = evidence / 'final-closeout-residual-path-safety-blocker.json'
        summary['status'] = 'BLOCKED'
        summary['cleanup']['unsafeBase'] = str(resolved)
        out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
        print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','path':str(out),'unsafeBase':str(resolved)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        raise SystemExit(5)
    for child in list(base.iterdir()):
        if child.name not in {'m','f','b'}:
            out = evidence / 'final-closeout-unexpected-residual-child-blocker.json'
            summary['status'] = 'BLOCKED'
            summary['cleanup']['unexpectedChild'] = str(child)
            out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
            print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','path':str(out),'unexpectedChild':str(child)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
            raise SystemExit(6)
        count = sum(1 for _ in child.rglob('*')) if child.is_dir() else 1
        shutil.rmtree(child, onerror=on_rm_error) if child.is_dir() else child.unlink()
        removed.append({'path': str(child), 'entryCountBefore': count})
    if base.exists() and not any(base.iterdir()):
        base.rmdir()
summary['cleanup']['removedResiduals'] = removed
summary['cleanup']['baseExistsAfterDelete'] = base.exists()
summary['cleanup']['runtimeHealthAfterDelete'] = health()
summary['cleanup']['registeredHitsAfterDelete'] = []
for repo in repos:
    listing = run(['git','-C',str(repo),'worktree','list','--porcelain'], timeout=120, check=True).stdout
    for line in listing.splitlines():
        if 'r260709ce' in line:
            summary['cleanup']['registeredHitsAfterDelete'].append({'repo': str(repo), 'line': line})

if base.exists() or summary['cleanup']['registeredHitsAfterDelete'] or not summary['cleanup']['runtimeHealthAfterDelete'].get('passed'):
    out = evidence / 'final-closeout-residual-cleanup-retry-failure.json'
    summary['status'] = 'FAILED'
    out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','path':str(out),'baseExists':base.exists(),'runtimeHealth':summary['cleanup']['runtimeHealthAfterDelete']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(7)

summary['status'] = 'SUCCESS'
closure_path = evidence / 'final-release-closeout-v10.json'
summary['closureEvidencePath'] = str(closure_path)
closure_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

exec_path = task / 'execution-log.md'
append_once(exec_path, 'GREEN: full three-environment release loop -> PASS', f'''\n## {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} final closeout\n\n- GREEN: full three-environment release loop -> PASS\n- ReleaseTag: `{release_tag}`\n- GREEN: build-release -> PASS\n- GREEN: publish-test -> PASS\n- GREEN: mark-tested -> PASS\n- GREEN: promote-prod -> PASS\n- GREEN: promote-backup -> PASS\n- GREEN: test/prod/backup remote verification -> PASS\n- GREEN: runtime-control main-path health after worktree delete -> PASS\n- GREEN: temporary release worktrees deleted -> PASS\n- Evidence: `{closure_path}`\n''')

task_md = task / 'task.md'
append_once(task_md, 'Status: Completed', f'''\n## Final Status\n\n- Status: Completed\n- ReleaseTag: `{release_tag}`\n- Scope: code-only / no data; build and deploy used `SkipDatabaseSync` and `SkipMinioSync`.\n- Completed loop: `build-release -> publish-test -> mark-tested -> promote-prod -> promote-backup`.\n- Verification: test/prod/backup `.env IMAGE_TAG`, backend/frontend image tags, backend health, frontend HTTP 200, PDF worker HTTP 200 all passed.\n- Backup extra verification: `/mnt/intruoyi-data` mounted from `/dev/mapper/cl-home`; release package under `/mnt/intruoyi-data/intruoyi-releases/{release_tag}`.\n- Runtime Control: main-path config restored and health `UP` after temp worktree deletion.\n- Temporary worktrees: `D:/ProjectPackage/Int/IntRuoyiWorktrees/r260709ce/m`, `b`, `f` deleted.\n- Final evidence: `doc/tasks/{task_id}/evidence/final-release-closeout-v10.json`.\n''')

req = root / 'docs' / 'request-command-log.md'
append_once(req, 'final closeout retry after runtime-control main-path restart', f'''\n## {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} {task_id}\n\n- Request: 完成发布闭环收尾，重新清理已注销的临时维护 worktree 残留，恢复主路径并提交隔离改动。\n- Command: confirm 48181 main-path process, remove residual `r260709ce`, verify runtime health, write final closeout evidence.\n- Evidence: `{closure_path}`.\n''')

# Stage and commit only current task docs/evidence plus direct experience docs.
cached_before = run(['git','-C',str(root),'diff','--cached','--name-only'], timeout=60, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
if cached_before:
    out = evidence / 'final-closeout-preexisting-staged-blocker.json'
    out.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','cachedBefore':cached_before}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','path':str(out),'cachedBefore':cached_before}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(8)
add_paths = [
    f'doc/tasks/{task_id}',
    'docs/experience-index.md',
    'docs/release-build-preflight-lessons.md',
    'docs/request-command-log.md',
]
run(['git','-C',str(root),'add','--'] + add_paths, timeout=180, check=True)
staged = run(['git','-C',str(root),'diff','--cached','--name-only'], timeout=60, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
allowed_prefix = f'doc/tasks/{task_id}/'
allowed_exact = {'docs/experience-index.md','docs/release-build-preflight-lessons.md','docs/request-command-log.md'}
disallowed = [p for p in staged if not (p.startswith(allowed_prefix) or p in allowed_exact)]
if disallowed:
    out = evidence / 'final-closeout-disallowed-staged-blocker.json'
    out.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','staged':staged,'disallowed':disallowed}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','path':str(out),'disallowed':disallowed}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(9)
commit_result = {'skipped': True, 'reason': 'no staged changes'}
if staged:
    commit = run(['git','-C',str(root),'commit','-m','任务: 完成code-only三环境发布闭环'], timeout=180)
    commit_result = {'exitCode': commit.returncode, 'stdout': commit.stdout, 'stderr': commit.stderr}
    if commit.returncode != 0:
        out = evidence / 'final-closeout-commit-failure.json'
        out.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','commit':commit_result,'staged':staged}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
        print(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','path':str(out),'commit':commit_result}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        raise SystemExit(10)
head_after = run(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD'], timeout=60, check=True).stdout.strip()
remaining = run(['git','-C',str(root),'status','--short'], timeout=60, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
print(json.dumps({
    'status': 'SUCCESS',
    'releaseTag': release_tag,
    'closurePath': str(closure_path),
    'worktreeBaseExists': base.exists(),
    'runtimeHealth': summary['cleanup']['runtimeHealthAfterDelete'],
    'stagedFiles': staged,
    'commit': commit_result,
    'headAfterCommit': head_after,
    'remainingStatus': remaining,
}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
